# Health Booker: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code b9d0e38a59fe · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Find and book yoga classes across Montréal studios with one account. Studios get scheduling, passes, teacher subs and pay, with no commission and no contract.
**Live:** https://health-booker.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/health-booker · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `health-booker/.claude/skills/healthbooker/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py healthbooker` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms conversion (branch `forms`, Nov 2026).** The guide named above still describes the old JavaScript layout; until it
  is rewritten, this map is the truth. Menu = `router.nav()` (by role: Discover, Practice, Teach for teachers, Studio for
  owners/desk), not a NAV list. `#studio/<slug>/solo` and `#class/<id>/solo` add `html.hb-solo` (hides the marketplace menu);
  `router.show()` removes it on every page change. `#kiosk` hides the frame (Shell class `no-chrome`); the kiosk's timers stop
  in its `leave()`, which `router.show()` calls.
- **`client_code/hb.py`** = the old window.HB: accents (`set_acc` puts `.acc-<key>` on a node: `--acc/--acc-soft`), money/time
  wording (local time through `window.HBD.fmt` in theme/assets/hb-draw.js), `fill()` (tags/badges as DOM spans, no HTML
  strings), and the shared flows: `book()` (server says `need: "waiver"` -> Dialogs/Waiver, `need: "pass"` -> Dialogs/Shop,
  then Dialogs/Booked), `cancel()`, `reflect()`, `roster()` (returns whether anything changed), `mark_paid()`.
- **JavaScript left** (theme/assets/hb-draw.js, wrapped by Components/MatGrid and Components/Chart): the room of mats
  (pick a mat; in Settings press to block), charts (12-week heat, mood line, bars, sales per day, fill by weekday x hour) with
  hover tips, practice stats in local time, .ics / CSV downloads, copy to clipboard.
- **Back office** = Pages/Manage (top + tab links) + one Form per tab in `client_code/Tabs/` made fresh on each visit.
- List items talk back through a `host` reference in the item dict (`item["host"].book_row(c, button)`), not events.
  Chips (`Items/Chip`) call `host.chip(group, key)`; `host.chip_panel_for(group)` keeps keyboard focus after a redraw.
- Colours were darkened to reach 4.5:1 (sage #4f6d53, clay #9c4f30, studio accents); `--c-accent-deco` is the old light
  clay for shapes only.
- Server fixes made on this branch: `len()` around two `search()` checks in Manage.client_detail / nudge (a search is always
  truthy); `my_practice` returned `MOODS` with int keys (Anvil can't send that; test_server.py now checks every reply);
  DemoData's full class wasn't full on Saturdays (pack credits ran out).
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py` runs tools/ui/smoke.js (every address signed out / member /
  admin, a booking end to end) at 1280 and 390 px.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/app.css` 1261, `anvil.yaml` 1147, `server_code/Manage.py` 822, `server_code/DemoData.py` 682, `server_code/Booking.py` 374, `client_code/hb.py` 367, `theme/assets/hb-draw.js` 309, `server_code/Model.py` 274

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
